name: Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)
description: Techniques by rank for every fighting style of the Six-Sided World: the Sword God, Water God and North God styles, Superd Spear, Beastfolk CQC, Demon Brawling, the arts of Battle Aura (Touki), the Dragon Race's own hand-to-hand, and the Greyrat Style founded by Ars Greyrat (fan addition). Made for the RPG Companion's technique list.

entries.content:
[SYSTEM LOGIC: SWORD TECHNIQUES BY RANK] (Added by @Mazaki)
Sword styles use the same seven ranks: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, Saint, King, Emperor, God. A technique entry ([TECHNIQUE — …]) states its style and the rank that can use it.
- {{user}} can use a technique only at or above its rank in that style, as the HUD's Sword Style line shows it. Above that, an attempt fails, comes out crude, or hurts the user.
- A technique is learned through teaching, drilling and a first clean execution in the story. Knowing about it, watching it, or one lucky success under pressure is not mastery.
- Saint-rank techniques and above need Battle Aura (Touki). Without Touki, the rank cannot pass Advanced.
- Rank-ups are earned: a teacher's recognition, a duel, or an exam at a dojo (the Sword Sanctum, the Water God dojo in Ars). The HUD line changes only when the story shows it.
- Entries marked FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON exist in this world but are rare: never taught at ordinary dojos, known to few.
- The Greyrat Style exists only after Ars Greyrat founds it (decades after the canon ending, around K450), unless the start says otherwise (Sandbox, Legend Start, or a stated divergence).
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword techniques: rules

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Sword God Stance] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Beginner
Effect: The foundational posture: sword raised high, torso open, weight forward. It commits the body to the first strike and teaches a student that hesitation is the real danger.
Requires: None. The first thing taught at any Sword God dojo.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Sword God Stance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Sword God Footwork] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Beginner
Effect: Staying on the balls of the feet so that falling forward becomes explosive forward momentum. Every later Sword God technique is built on it.
Requires: Daily drilling; usually taught with the stance.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Sword God Footwork

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Flash Slash] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: A dash that ends in a cut: mana gathered in the soles, the swordsman appears as a streak and strikes before the opponent has drawn.
Requires: Sword God Footwork. Some control over mana in the body.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Flash Slash

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Flash] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Advanced
Effect: The full gap-closer: Battle Aura poured into calves and tendons to cross about twenty metres at once, cratering the ground at the start.
Requires: Flash Slash; the first real use of Battle Aura in the legs.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Flash

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Swallow Reversal] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Advanced
Effect: A feint so complete that the opponent commits to the block, then the blade changes path mid-swing to the other side of the neck.
Requires: Reliable control of the sword's line at full speed.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Swallow Reversal

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Longsword of Light] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Saint
Effect: The style's supreme technique: all Battle Aura in one blindingly fast slash past the speed of sound. A sure kill if it lands; the follow-through leaves the user open. Performing it perfectly is what makes a Sword Saint.
Requires: Battle Aura and full Sword God fundamentals. Timothy Britts insists the off hand is mastered first.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Longsword of Light

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Silent Strike] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: King
Effect: The Longsword's violence without its sound: Battle Aura released with no burst of noise, so nothing is heard until the head is already off.
Requires: Longsword of Light, and fine control of Battle Aura.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Silent Strike

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Lightning Flash] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: King
Effect: A faster Longsword of Light: a little mana run through the user's own nerves to pass pain and reaction limits. Costly to the body.
Requires: Longsword of Light.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Lightning Flash

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Light Reversal] (Sword God Style)
Style: Sword God · Rank: Emperor
Effect: The answer to the Longsword of Light: the user starts their own a fraction later, uses the clash to throw the enemy's blade aside and cuts in the same motion.
Requires: Longsword of Light performed at will, and the nerve to wait for the enemy's.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Light Reversal

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Formless Light] (Sword God Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Sword God · Rank: God
Effect: The Longsword of Light from any position, with no stance and no wind-up: walking, falling, mid-sentence. There is no tell to read.
Requires: Sword Emperor mastery. Said to be what separates the Sword God from everyone else at the Sanctum.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Sword God Style: Formless Light

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Water God Stance] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Beginner
Effect: Blade low, often pointing at the ground, centre of gravity dropped: a defensive sphere the enemy must enter first.
Requires: None. Taught first, together with patience.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Water God Stance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Flowing Counter] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: The basic counter: catch the enemy blade on the curve of one's own, slide past it and cut the overextended wrist or throat.
Requires: Water God Stance held under pressure.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Flowing Counter

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Mirror Reflect] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Matching the vibration of an incoming physical strike to absorb its force and send it back at the attacker.
Requires: Flowing Counter, and a feel for an opponent's weight and rhythm.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Mirror Reflect

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Flowing Water] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Saint
Effect: The style's signature: a near-perfect parry of almost any attack, magical projectiles and attacks from several directions included, with the force returned in the counter. Unlocking it is what makes a Water Saint.
Requires: Battle Aura and full Water God fundamentals.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Flowing Water

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Void Parry] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Saint
Effect: Parrying what has no shape: the blade vibrates at high frequency inside Battle Aura so it can catch magic and other formless attacks.
Requires: Flowing Water.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Void Parry

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Mirror Break] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: King
Effect: Instead of parrying, the user meets the strike at the enemy blade's weak point and shatters lesser steel on contact.
Requires: Flowing Water, and an eye for a weapon's flaws.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Mirror Break

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Absolute Zero Parry] (Water God Style)
Style: Water God · Rank: Emperor
Effect: Battle Aura laid on the blade as a film of perfect stillness: whatever touches it loses all momentum, and the attacker is frozen for a heartbeat.
Requires: Water King mastery.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Absolute Zero Parry

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Water God's Domain] (Water God Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Water God · Rank: God
Effect: Reida's ultimate: inside the reach of the sword, any aggressive movement at all is parried and answered with a beheading in the same instant. The Water God does not move first and does not need to.
Requires: Water God title. The Water God style's five secret arts, at least three of them mastered.
Note: Effect from the lorebook's description of Reida Lia's ultimate technique; the name is this book's.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Water God Style: Water God's Domain

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Feint Strike] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Beginner
Effect: Swing at an impossible angle to force a block, cancel, and stab with a concealed shiv. Built to exploit the rigid habits of Sword God students.
Requires: A second blade on the body.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Feint Strike

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Disarming Throw] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Beginner
Effect: Throw the main weapon at the face; while it is blocked or dodged, draw the hidden second blade and strike the blind spot.
Requires: A hidden secondary blade.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Disarming Throw

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Earth Shaker] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Drive the sword or a heel into the ground hard enough to make a local tremor. It does not kill; it ruins the stance for the next strike.
Requires: Enough strength or Battle Aura in the legs.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Earth Shaker

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Four Legged Stance] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Drop to all fours like an animal: very low, very hard to hit, with erratic upward-springing slashes that pass under ordinary guards.
Requires: Flexibility and no shame.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Four Legged Stance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Phantom Blade] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Advanced
Effect: A wide swing of the main sword as the distraction, while the hidden dagger or knife goes into the vitals.
Requires: Feint Strike.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Phantom Blade

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Mirage] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Stepping out of the opponent's rhythm so they strike a lingering afterimage, then attacking from the blind angle.
Requires: A good read of the opponent's tempo.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Mirage

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Death From Below] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: Saint
Effect: A tunnelling stance that strikes from under the feet while the enemy guards the head. An assassin's technique.
Requires: Four Legged Stance, great flexibility, and a short serrated blade.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Death From Below

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Oboro Cross] (North God Style)
Style: North God · Rank: King
Effect: Overlapping dual-wield strike: one blade traps the enemy weapon while the other kills. Deadly against single-blade swordsmen.
Requires: Dual wielding, the mark of a North King.
Note: Rank: set for this book; the older lorebook text gives no exact tier.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Oboro Cross

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Painted Ruin] (North God Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: North God · Rank: Emperor
Effect: The North Emperor's battlefield: smoke, blinding paint, thrown oil, loose ground and noise prepared in advance, so the fight happens inside the user's trap.
Requires: North King mastery and time to prepare the ground. Modelled on North Emperor Auber Corvette's way of fighting.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Painted Ruin

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Immortal's Gambit] (North God Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: North God · Rank: God
Effect: Taking a wound that looks fatal on purpose, falling as if dead, and killing the opponent in the moment they relax. Kalman's school was founded by a hero who survived what should have killed him.
Requires: North God title; a body hard enough to survive the wound.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] North God Style: Immortal's Gambit

entries.content:
[SWORD STYLE — GREYRAT STYLE] (Added by @Mazaki)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: there is no fourth great style in the novels; this is this world's own.)
Founder: Ars Greyrat, Rudeus and Eris's son, a master swordsman raised on his mother's Sword God Style who also learned the Water God and North God styles. He founds it as a grown man, decades after the canon ending (around K450).
Idea: no school is complete alone. The Greyrat Style switches between the three great styles inside one fight: Sword God to end it, Water God to survive it, North God to win it however possible. Its students are taught to protect first.
Ranks: the usual seven (Beginner to God). The title of its master is "Greyrat" plus the rank (Greyrat Saint, Greyrat King…). No one but Ars holds God rank.
Entry: a student must already be Beginner in all three great styles; most are Advanced in at least two.
Where: taught by Ars in Sharia, at first only to family and a few chosen students; there is no public dojo in his lifetime.
Before it exists: earlier in the timeline, nobody can learn it, and asking about it gets blank looks.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style (fan addition)

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Three-Root Stance] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: Beginner
Effect: A stance that can become the Sword God, Water God or North God stance in one step, so the opponent never knows which school they are facing.
Requires: Beginner in all three of the great styles.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Three-Root Stance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Turning Tide] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: A Water God parry that turns straight into a Sword God dash: the defence is the start of the attack.
Requires: Flowing Counter and Flash Slash.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Turning Tide

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Wolf's Gambit] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: Advanced
Effect: A North God feint backed by a full Sword God commitment: the fake is real enough to kill if it is ignored.
Requires: Feint Strike and Flash.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Wolf's Gambit

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Red Lion's Light] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: Saint
Effect: The Longsword of Light released from inside a parry, using the enemy's own force as its run-up. Ars's answer to his mother's style.
Requires: Longsword of Light and Flowing Water.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Red Lion's Light

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Hearthguard] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: King
Effect: Holding a space behind the sword that nothing passes: every attack aimed at the people the user protects is drawn onto the blade instead. Born from Ars's habit of standing in front of his siblings.
Requires: Red Lion's Light; Water God footwork at Saint level.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Hearthguard

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Mad Lion's Inheritance] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: Emperor
Effect: Eris's berserk tempo, held on a leash: the user fights at the Mad Sword King's speed and ferocity but keeps a clear head and can stop at any moment.
Requires: Sword King mastery in the Sword God Style, and a teacher who survived Eris.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Mad Lion's Inheritance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Greyrat's Answer] (Greyrat Style)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: part of Ars Greyrat's own style; see GREYRAT STYLE.)
Style: Greyrat · Rank: God
Effect: Reading which school an opponent fights in and answering with the one that beats it, changing every exchange. The style's founding idea taken to its end.
Requires: Mastery of the whole Greyrat Style. Only its founder has shown it.
Unique to: Ars Greyrat and the students he teaches.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Greyrat Style: Greyrat's Answer

entries.content:
[SYSTEM LOGIC: OTHER FIGHTING STYLES AND BATTLE AURA] (Added by @Mazaki)
- Superd Spear, Beastfolk CQC and Demon Brawling use the same seven ranks as the sword styles (Beginner to God) and go on the HUD's Sword Style line with them: "Superd Spear (King)", "Beastfolk CQC (Advanced)". The same learning rules apply.
- Superd Spear is taught by Superd (Ruijerd) and only to people they trust; its Third-Eye techniques need a Superd's forehead gem. Beastfolk CQC is taught in the Great Forest; a human can learn it but never with beastfolk senses. Demon Brawling is learned in the Demon Continent's fights; its regeneration techniques need a demon body.
- Battle Aura (Touki) techniques follow the HUD's Touki line: Awakening, then Active (conscious control), then Mastered (complete control). Locked or sealed Touki (Rudeus's Laplace Factor) means none of them.
- The Dragon Race's hand-to-hand is not taught to outsiders. Its techniques are unique to Orsted and his kind.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Other fighting styles and Battle Aura: rules

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Spear Dance Stance] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Beginner
Effect: The spear never stops: it turns around the body in a constant circle, so every guard is already the start of a strike and every strike returns to a guard.
Requires: A spear and a teacher of the Superd way. Ruijerd teaches it to those he trusts.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Spear Dance Stance

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Tri-Prong Sweep] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: A low spinning sweep with the three prongs that hooks ankles and blades alike, and pulls the enemy into the next turn of the dance.
Requires: Spear Dance Stance held at speed.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Tri-Prong Sweep

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Unbroken Circle] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Advanced
Effect: The spin becomes a wall: arrows, thrown blades and clumsy spells are knocked aside by the turning shaft while the warrior keeps walking forward.
Requires: Tri-Prong Sweep, and the endurance to keep the circle turning for minutes.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Unbroken Circle

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Third-Eye Feint] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Reading the opponent's life-force through the forehead gem and striking where they are about to move, not where they are. Others cannot use it; a Superd learns it young.
Requires: The Superd's Third Eye (the red forehead gem). Non-Superd cannot learn it.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Third-Eye Feint

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Thousand Cuts] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Saint
Effect: The flexible bone-spear vibrates into a blur and strikes hundreds of times in a second. Each cut is shallow; together they bleed the target out.
Requires: Battle Aura, and a Superd spear or one made the Superd way.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Thousand Cuts

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Warrior's Thrust] (Superd Spear)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: King
Effect: One straight thrust carrying the whole momentum of the dance: the spear stops spinning for a single instant and goes through Battle Aura, armour and the man behind them.
Requires: Thousand Cuts, and full control of Battle Aura.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Warrior's Thrust

keys: Superd Spear: Lament of the Spear
entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Lament of the Spear] (Superd Spear)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: Emperor
Effect: The dance that once made the Superd feared in the Laplace War, fought with a clear head: the warrior moves through a crowd and leaves no one standing who raised a weapon. Children and the unarmed are untouched.
Requires: Superd Spear King mastery. Modelled on what Ruijerd could do at his peak.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Lament of the Spear

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Guardian's Oath] (Superd Spear)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Superd Spear · Rank: God
Effect: The spear answers every attack aimed at the people behind the warrior before it lands, from any side at once, for as long as the warrior still stands.
Requires: Superd Spear Emperor mastery and a sworn charge to protect. Nobody living is known to hold it.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Superd Spear: Guardian's Oath

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Low Prowl] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Beginner
Effect: A crouched, springing stance that keeps the centre of gravity under the opponent's and the claws ready. The first lesson in the Doldia villages.
Requires: Beastfolk blood, or a Great Forest teacher and a lot of bruises.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Low Prowl

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Hamstring Rake] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: A dive past the guard to claw the back of the knee: the opponent goes down, and the fight goes to the ground where beastfolk are strongest.
Requires: Low Prowl; claws, or a short curved knife held the beastfolk way.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Hamstring Rake

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Pounce Takedown] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Advanced
Effect: A leap onto the opponent's centre of gravity that ends with them on their back and the beastfolk on their chest, pinning both arms.
Requires: Hamstring Rake, and the legs for a standing leap of several metres.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Pounce Takedown

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Scent Reading] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Fighting by smell and hearing as much as sight: fear-sweat, the creak of a drawn bow and a held breath tell the beastfolk where the next attack comes from, even in darkness.
Requires: Beastfolk senses. A human can only train a rough version of it.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Scent Reading

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Throat Lock] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Saint
Effect: A grapple that turns any hold into an exposed throat, sealed with Battle Aura in the grip. Once it closes, only greater strength breaks it.
Requires: Pounce Takedown and Battle Aura.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Throat Lock

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Great Forest Howl] (Beastfolk CQC)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: King
Effect: A roar carried on Battle Will Aura that freezes the prey for a heartbeat, long enough to close the distance and finish it.
Requires: Throat Lock, and Battle Will Aura.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Great Forest Howl

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Moonfang Frenzy] (Beastfolk CQC)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: Emperor
Effect: A chain of acrobatic strikes off walls, trees and the enemy's own body, never touching the ground twice in the same place.
Requires: Beastfolk CQC King mastery.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Moonfang Frenzy

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Beast God's Hunt] (Beastfolk CQC)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Beastfolk CQC · Rank: God
Effect: The hunt as the Great Forest's warrior-chiefs tell of it: the prey is read, cornered and finished before it understands it is being hunted.
Requires: Beastfolk CQC Emperor mastery. Told of the greatest Doldia warriors; no one in this era is known to hold it.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Beastfolk CQC: Beast God's Hunt

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Horn Charge] (Demon Brawling)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: Beginner
Effect: Head down, horns (or skull) first, everything behind it. Crude, and it works on anyone who expected a fair fight.
Requires: A thick skull. Demon Continent street fights teach it.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Horn Charge

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Trade Blow] (Demon Brawling)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: Intermediate
Effect: Taking the opponent's hit on purpose to land one of your own in the same moment. The brawler bets the body can take it.
Requires: Toughness, or Battle Aura at least awakening.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Trade Blow

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Extra-Limb Lock] (Demon Brawling)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: Advanced
Effect: Using a tail, extra arms, wings or horns to pin the opponent's weapon while the hands do the real damage. Without extra limbs, it becomes a knee-and-elbow lock.
Requires: Trade Blow. Full use needs the body of a demon race that has them.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Extra-Limb Lock

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Crippling Exchange] (Demon Brawling)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: Saint
Effect: Aiming at the one place the opponent cannot afford to lose, an eye, a knee, the sword hand, and accepting the same wound in return.
Requires: Battle Aura, and either demonic regeneration or very good healing nearby.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Crippling Exchange

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Regeneration Rush] (Demon Brawling)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: King
Effect: Fighting through wounds that would stop anyone else, because they close behind the brawler as fast as they open.
Requires: A demon race with fast regeneration (an Immortal Demon's line, for example).
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Regeneration Rush

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Crater Fist] (Demon Brawling)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: Emperor
Effect: A punch with Battle Aura compressed into the knuckles that leaves a crater where the target stood.
Requires: Demon Brawling King mastery.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Crater Fist

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Immortal's Laughter] (Demon Brawling)
(FAN ADDITION — NOT CANON: rare; known to few and never taught at ordinary dojos.)
Style: Demon Brawling · Rank: God
Effect: Fighting as the Immortal Demon Kings do: laughing, unafraid, taking every blow and returning worse. Nothing in the fight is treated as a threat.
Requires: Demon Brawling Emperor mastery and a body that cannot die easily. Modelled on Badigadi and Atoferatofe.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Demon Brawling: Immortal's Laughter

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Aura Guard] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Awakening
Effect: Battle Aura pushed to where the blow lands. A beginner does it by instinct; it turns a broken arm into a bruise.
Requires: Battle Aura that has started to show.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Aura Guard

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Touki Hardening] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Active
Effect: Condensing Battle Aura into one forearm or blade instead of the whole body: that limb gains the durability and cutting power of King-tier magic.
Requires: Conscious control of Battle Aura (Active).
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Touki Hardening

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Touki Burst] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Active
Effect: Releasing all stored Battle Aura in one explosion from the skin: everyone close is thrown back and incoming weapons shatter. The user is left exhausted.
Requires: Conscious control of Battle Aura (Active). A last resort.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Touki Burst

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Internal Armor] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Mastered
Effect: Battle Aura turned inward to harden the organs, so being slammed into a boulder or hit by concussive magic does not rupture anything.
Requires: Complete control of Battle Aura (Mastered).
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Internal Armor

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Battle Will Aura] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Mastered
Effect: Battle Aura that presses on everyone nearby: weaker fighters lose their nerve, and much weaker ones cannot move at all.
Requires: Complete control of Battle Aura (Mastered).
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Battle Will Aura

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Touki Shaping] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Mastered
Effect: Extending Battle Aura past the body: a blade that reaches further than its steel, a fist that hits a step away.
Requires: Complete control of Battle Aura (Mastered). Rare even among masters.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Touki Shaping

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Touki Suppression Aura] (Battle Aura)
Style: Touki · Rank: Mastered
Effect: An aura that breaks down the opponent's Battle Aura, so they are as brittle as someone who never had any. Used by the top of the North God style.
Requires: Complete control of Battle Aura (Mastered), and years of fighting other aura users.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Touki: Touki Suppression Aura

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Relaxed Palm] (Dragon Race hand-to-hand)
Style: Dragon God · Rank: Unique
Effect: A simple, unhurried palm strike that kills, because every part of the body moves in perfect order behind it.
Unique to: Orsted and the Dragon Race.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Dragon Race: Relaxed Palm

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Bare-Hand Parry] (Dragon Race hand-to-hand)
Style: Dragon God · Rank: Unique
Effect: Catching or turning aside legendary weapons with the bare hands, with Holy Dragon Aura and exact timing.
Unique to: Orsted and the Dragon Race.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Dragon Race: Bare-Hand Parry

entries.content:
[TECHNIQUE — Holy Dragon Aura] (Dragon Race hand-to-hand)
Style: Dragon God · Rank: Unique
Effect: The Dragon God Urupen's secret technique: a Battle Aura beyond anyone else's, the base of all Dragon Race hand-to-hand.
Unique to: The Dragon Gods and those they teach. Orsted.
entries.comment: [Mushoku Tensei - Combat Techniques (Mazaki)] Dragon Race: Holy Dragon Aura
